title: 第9章 立威慑敌第10章 谷中潜修
lines: 王龙三人狼狈退去时带起的窸窣声和压抑的痛哼，很快被葬剑谷浓重的雾气和死寂吞没。
河谷边，只剩下云澈粗重的喘息声，以及溪水兀自流淌的潺潺音。
确认威胁暂时解除，云澈强撑着的身体猛地一晃，再也支撑不住，单膝跪倒在地，断剑“呛啷”
一声拄在溪边的碎石上，才勉强没有瘫软下去。
冷汗如同瀑布般从额角、鬓边涌出，瞬间浸湿了本就褴褛的衣襟。
脸色苍白得没有一丝血色，嘴唇因脱力和先前的紧绷而微微颤抖。
刚才那电光火石间的交锋，看似他以绝对的优势碾压了对手，只有他自己清楚，其中蕴含了多少凶险与勉强。
强行催动剑感滞涩的身体施展“破风式”
，对精神和肉体的负担远超想象。
那一剑刺出时，他感觉自己的灵魂仿佛都被抽离了一部分，与断剑之间那种玄妙的联系时断时续，若非凭借着一股不甘屈服的狠劲和对剑招拓印时的深刻记忆强行完成，恐怕中途就会招式变形，后果不堪设想。
“还是……太弱了……”
云澈咬着牙，感受着体内空荡荡的虚脱感和脑海深处隐隐传来的、剑噬残留的钝痛，一股强烈的不甘涌上心头。
仅仅对付三个最低级的杂役，其中只有一个勉强算是踏入剑徒门槛的王龙，就让自己几乎耗尽心力。
若是云昊亲自前来，或者宗门派出更厉害的执法弟子，自己又将如何应对？
实力的绝对差距，像冰冷的巨石压在他的心头。
但很快，这股不甘就被更强烈的求生欲和复仇之火点燃。
他深吸了几口谷中冰冷潮湿的空气，强迫自己冷静下来，分析当前的处境。
云澈知道，王龙败退，消息很快就会传回宗门。
云昊得知自己不仅没死，反而疑似恢复了部分实力，接下来只会派出更厉害、更谨慎的追杀者。
这葬剑谷，不再仅仅是环境恶劣的绝地，更成了一个随时可能被敌人闯入的狩猎场。
原地停留，等于坐以待毙。
必须尽快离开这片相对开阔的河谷地带，找到一个更隐蔽、更易守难攻的落脚点。
同时，必须尽快提升实力！
《青锋三式》虽精妙，但毕竟只是基础，且在自己手中威力大打折扣。
需要更多的剑招，更深的感悟，更需要……找到能缓解“剑噬”
之苦的“剑髓石”
content_en:
The rustling sounds and suppressed groans of pain caused by Wang Long and the other two people as they retreated in embarrassment were quickly swallowed up by the thick fog and dead silence of Sword Burial Valley.
By the river valley, the only sounds left were Yun Che's heavy breathing and the gurgling sound of the stream.
After confirming that the threat was temporarily lifted, Yun Che's body that was holding on forcibly swayed violently. He could no longer hold it up and fell to the ground on one knee. The broken sword "choked"
He leaned on the gravel by the stream and barely managed not to collapse.
Cold sweat poured out from his forehead and temples like a waterfall, instantly soaking his already ragged clothes.
His face was so pale that there was no trace of blood, and his lips were trembling slightly from the tension and tension.
In the confrontation between lightning and flint just now, it seemed that he had crushed his opponent with an absolute advantage. Only he knew how much danger and reluctance it contained.
Forcibly urge the body with stagnant sword sense to perform "Breaking Wind Style"
, the burden on the spirit and body is far beyond imagination.
When the sword thrust out, he felt as if a part of his soul had been pulled away, and the mysterious connection with the broken sword was intermittent. If he hadn't relied on a fierceness that was unwilling to give in and a deep memory of the sword's rubbing to complete it, I'm afraid the move would have deformed midway, and the consequences would be disastrous.
"It's still...too weak..."
Yun Che gritted his teeth, feeling the empty feeling of exhaustion in his body and the dull pain left by the sword bite in the depths of his mind, and a strong sense of unwillingness surged into his heart.
Just dealing with three low-level servants, only one of whom, Wang Long, could barely be considered as a swordsman, almost exhausted all his energy.
If Yun Hao comes in person, or if the sect sends more powerful law enforcement disciples, how will he respond?
The absolute gap in strength weighed on his heart like a cold boulder.
But soon, this unwillingness was ignited by a stronger desire for survival and revenge.
He took a few deep breaths of the cold, humid air in the valley, forcing himself to calm down and analyze the current situation.
Yun Che knew that the news of Wang Long's defeat would soon be spread back to the sect.
Yun Hao learned that not only was he not dead, but he was suspected of having recovered some of his strength, and he would only send out more powerful and cautious pursuers.
The Sword Burial Valley is no longer just a Jedi with a harsh environment, but has become a hunting ground that may be invaded by enemies at any time.
Staying where you are is tantamount to sitting back and waiting for death.
We must leave this relatively open river valley as soon as possible and find a more secluded foothold that is easier to defend and harder to attack.
At the same time, we must improve our strength as soon as possible!
Although "Qing Feng Three Styles" is exquisite, it is only the basis after all, and its power is greatly reduced in your own hands.
We need more sword moves, deeper insights, and even more... find a way to alleviate the "sword bite"
The painful "Sword Marrow Stone"
